text.id: Tema seni dan legenda sejak prasejarah; laporan kucing domestik bersayap tertua yang diketahui berasal dari Juni 1842
text.en: A theme in art and legend since prehistory; the earliest known report of a winged domestic cat dates from June 1842

short_description.id: Kucing bersayap adalah felid dengan sayap seperti burung atau kelelawar, tema seni dan legenda sejak prasejarah. Kucing domestik bersayap kini dikenal sebagai legenda urban dengan penjelasan medis.
short_description.en: The winged cat is a feline with bird-like or bat-like wings, a theme in art and legend since prehistory. Winged domestic cats are now known as an urban legend with medical explanations.

long_description.id: Kucing bersayap adalah felid yang digambarkan bersayap seperti burung, kelelawar, atau makhluk terbang lain. Menurut sumber pertama, tema ini sudah ada dalam seni dan legenda sejak prasejarah, terutama pada gambaran kucing besar bersayap elang di Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.
long_description.en: The winged cat is a feline depicted with wings like those of a bird, a bat or another flying creature. According to the first source, the theme goes back to prehistory in art and legend, especially in pictures of large cats bearing eagle wings across Eurasia and North Africa.

long_description.id: Singa bersayap dan pantherin bersayap lain umum dalam seni religius dan mitologis bangsa Sumeria, Mesopotamia lain, Akkadia, Persia, dan Skithia. Aq Bars, macan tutul salju bersayap, adalah lambang berasal Turkic dan Bulgar kuno. Dalam Kitab Daniel, binatang pertama dalam penglihatan tentang binatang dari laut menyerupai singa bersayap, dan dalam Kekristenan abad pertengahan setan kadang digambarkan sebagai kucing bersayap kelelawar. Dalam gambaran Nordik, kucing-kucing dewi Freyja juga bersayap.
long_description.en: Winged lions and other winged pantherines are common in the religious and mythological art of the Sumerians, other Mesopotamians, Akkadians, Persians and Scythians. Aq Bars, the winged snow leopard, is a symbol of ancient Turkic and Bulgar origin. In the Book of Daniel, the opening beast of the vision of creatures rising from the sea looks like a winged lion, and in medieval Christianity demons were sometimes depicted as bat-winged cats. In the Norse imagery the cats of the goddess Freyja are also winged.

long_description.id: Kepercayaan akan kucing domestik bersayap bertahan sebagai legenda urban. Penampakannya dijelaskan secara medis oleh rambut kusut, kulit longgar, atau anggota tubuh tambahan di dekat bahu yang mengepak saat kucing berlari, dan tidak ada bukti sayap sungguhan seperti sayap burung atau kelelawar.
long_description.en: Belief in winged domestic cats persists as an urban legend. Sightings are explained medically by matted hair, loose skin or extra limbs near the shoulders that flap as the cat runs, and there is no evidence of true bird-like or bat-like wings.

long_description.id: Laporan tertua yang diketahui berasal dari Henry David Thoreau, yang mencatat kunjungan pada Juni 1842 ke seekor kucing yang sedang berburu di hutan. Menurut pemiliknya, bulu kucing itu menebal dan memipih di sisi tubuhnya pada musim dingin; sebagian orang mengira ia sebagian tupai terbang atau hewan liar lain. Artikel berbahasa Jepang juga mencatat penangkapan hewan berwajah kucing yang bersayap pada 1826 di Jepang.
long_description.en: The earliest known report comes from Henry David Thoreau, who recorded a visit in June 1842 to a cat that was out hunting in the woods. According to its owner, the cat's fur grew thick and flattened along its sides in winter; some thought it partly a flying squirrel or other wild animal. The Japanese-language article also records the capture of a winged, cat-faced animal in Japan in 1826.

who.en: The winged cat is a feline with the wings of a bird, bat or other flying creature.

origin.id: Temanya sudah ada dalam seni dan legenda sejak prasejarah di Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.
origin.en: The theme goes back to prehistory in art and legend in Eurasia and North Africa.

role.id: Dalam seni kuno ia muncul sebagai singa dan pantherin bersayap; kini ia juga hadir sebagai legenda urban.
role.en: In ancient art it appears as winged lions and pantherines; today it also appears as an urban legend.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal lewat laporan kucing domestik bersayap yang dijelaskan sebagai rambut kusut atau kelainan kulit.
famous_for.en: It is known through reports of winged domestic cats explained as matted hair or skin conditions.

did_you_know.id: Laporan tertua yang kini diketahui tentang kucing bersayap berasal dari Henry David Thoreau, yang berkunjung pada Juni 1842.
did_you_know.en: The earliest currently known report of a winged cat comes from Henry David Thoreau, who made a visit in June 1842.

description.en: Thoreau records a visit to a cat called winged; this is named the earliest known report.

learning_questions.en: How can scientific explanations and folk accounts of winged cats coexist?

claims.quote: The winged cat – a feline with wings like a bird, bat or other flying creature – is a theme in artwork and legend going back to prehistory, especially mythological depictions of big cats with eagle wings in Eurasia and North Africa.

statement.id: Kucing bersayap, yaitu felid dengan sayap seperti burung, kelelawar, atau makhluk terbang lain, adalah tema seni dan legenda sejak prasejarah, terutama gambaran mitologis kucing besar bersayap elang di Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.
statement.en: The winged cat, a feline with wings like a bird, bat or other flying creature, is a theme in art and legend going back to prehistory, especially mythological depictions of big cats with eagle wings in Eurasia and North Africa.

claims.quote: Pantherines with wings, especially winged lions, are a common theme in ancient religious and mythological art of the Sumerians and other Mesopotamians, Akkadians, Persians, and Scythians

statement.id: Pantherin bersayap, terutama singa bersayap, adalah tema umum dalam seni religius dan mitologis kuno bangsa Sumeria dan Mesopotamia lain, Akkadia, Persia, dan Skithia.
statement.en: Winged pantherines, especially winged lions, are a common theme in the ancient religious and mythological art of the Sumerians and other Mesopotamians, Akkadians, Persians and Scythians.

claims.quote: Aq Bars is a legendary winged snow leopard, a symbol of ancient Turkic and Bulgar origin, and going back to an uncertain period in pre-literate history.

statement.id: Aq Bars adalah macan tutul salju bersayap yang legendaris, lambang berasal Turkic dan Bulgar kuno, yang berakar pada masa tak pasti sebelum tulisan.
statement.en: Aq Bars is a legendary winged snow leopard, a symbol of ancient Turkic and Bulgar origin going back to an uncertain pre-literate period.

claims.quote: In the Book of Daniel of the Hebrew Bible and Christian Old Testament, the first beast in the vision of the beasts from the sea (chapter 7, dating to around the 2nd century BC) resembled a winged lion.

statement.id: Dalam Kitab Daniel, binatang pertama dalam penglihatan tentang binatang-binatang dari laut (pasal 7) menyerupai singa bersayap.
statement.en: In the Book of Daniel, the first beast in the vision of the beasts from the sea (chapter 7) resembled a winged lion.

claims.quote: In later, medieval Christianity, both cats (of the domestic sort) and bats were associated with the Devil, and demons were sometimes depicted as bat-winged cats.

statement.id: Dalam Kekristenan abad pertengahan, kucing domestik dan kelelawar dikaitkan dengan Iblis, dan setan kadang digambarkan sebagai kucing bersayap kelelawar.
statement.en: In medieval Christianity, domestic cats and bats were associated with the Devil, and demons were sometimes depicted as bat-winged cats.

claims.quote: Belief in domestic cats with wings persists to the present day as an urban legend.

statement.id: Kepercayaan akan kucing domestik bersayap bertahan hingga kini sebagai legenda urban.
statement.en: Belief in domestic cats with wings persists to the present day as an urban legend.

claims.quote: Sightings of cats with supposed wings are easily explained by medical conditions that can result in matted hair, loose skin, or supernumerary limbs on or near the shoulders, that flap about in a wing-like manner as the cat runs.

statement.id: Penampakan kucing yang konon bersayap mudah dijelaskan oleh kondisi medis: rambut kusut, kulit longgar, atau anggota tubuh tambahan di dekat bahu yang mengepak seperti sayap saat kucing berlari.
statement.en: Sightings of supposedly winged cats are easily explained by medical conditions such as matted hair, loose skin or supernumerary limbs on or near the shoulders that flap like wings as the cat runs.

claims.quote: There is no evidence of actual bird- or bat-like wings, and there is no scientific reason to believe such a thing is possible.

statement.id: Tidak ada bukti sayap sungguhan seperti sayap burung atau kelelawar pada kucing, dan tidak ada alasan ilmiah untuk percaya hal itu mungkin.
statement.en: There is no evidence of actual bird-like or bat-like wings on cats, and no scientific reason to believe such a thing is possible.

claims.quote: The earliest currently known report of a winged cat is from Henry David Thoreau:

statement.id: Laporan tertua yang kini diketahui tentang kucing bersayap berasal dari Henry David Thoreau.
statement.en: The earliest currently known report of a winged cat is from Henry David Thoreau.

claims.quote: When I called to see her in June, 1842, she was gone a-hunting in the woods, as was her wont

statement.id: Thoreau mencatat kunjungannya pada Juni 1842 untuk melihat kucing itu, yang saat itu sedang berburu di hutan seperti kebiasaannya.
statement.en: Thoreau records calling to see the cat in June 1842, when she had gone hunting in the woods as was her wont.

claims.quote: that in the winter the fur grew thick and flatted out along her sides, forming stripes ten or twelve inches long by two and a half wide

statement.id: Menurut penuturan pemilik, pada musim dingin bulunya menebal dan memipih di sisi tubuhnya, membentuk jalur sepanjang sepuluh atau dua belas inci dan lebar dua setengah inci.
statement.en: According to the owner, in winter the fur grew thick and flattened along her sides, forming stripes ten or twelve inches long by two and a half wide.

claims.quote: Some thought it was part flying-squirrel or some other wild animal, which is not impossible

statement.id: Sebagian orang mengira kucing itu sebagian tupai terbang atau hewan liar lain.
statement.en: Some people thought the cat was partly a flying squirrel or some other wild animal.

claims.quote: 1826年、日本の駿河国有渡郡小鹿村にて、顔が猫で翼の生えた動物が捕獲される

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Jepang mencatat bahwa pada 1826 di desa Oshika, Distrik Ado, Provinsi Suruga, Jepang, ditangkap hewan berwajah kucing yang bersayap (翼).
statement.en: The Japanese-language article records that in 1826 an animal with a cat's face and wings (翼) was captured in Oshika village, Ado district, Suruga province, Japan.

claims.quote: Dans le domaine imaginaire, des chats ailés sont également présents, bien qu'en général pourvus d'ailes véritables, tels les chats de la déesse nordique Freyja.

statement.id: Dalam ranah imajiner juga ada kucing bersayap (chats ailés), umumnya bersayap sungguhan, seperti kucing-kucing milik dewi Nordik Freyja.
statement.en: In the imaginary realm winged cats (chats ailés) also appear, generally with true wings, such as the cats of the Norse goddess Freyja.

claims.quote: Catwings, a 1988–1999 series of children's picture books by Ursula K. Le Guin, features several winged cats.

statement.id: Catwings adalah serangkaian buku bergambar anak 1988–1999 karya Ursula K. Le Guin yang menampilkan beberapa kucing bersayap.
statement.en: Catwings is a 1988–1999 series of children's picture books by Ursula K. Le Guin featuring several winged cats.

summary.id: Artikel pertama menjelaskan penampakan sebagai rambut kusut, kulit longgar, atau anggota tambahan, dan menyebut tidak ada bukti sayap sungguhan.
summary.en: The first article explains sightings as matted hair, loose skin or extra limbs and says there is no evidence of true wings.

summary.id: Menurut Thoreau, sebagian orang mengira kucing bersayap yang ia lihat sebagian tupai terbang atau hewan liar lain.
summary.en: According to Thoreau, some people thought the winged cat he saw was partly a flying squirrel or other wild animal.

gaps.searched: Tidak ada berkas Commons yang jelas menggambarkan kucing bersayap sebagai makhluk ini; gambar singa bersayap tidak dipakai karena bukan kucing bersayap yang dimaksud.
Nama adalah istilah deskriptif; tidak ada sumber yang membahas asal kata.
Kutipan hanya mendukung sebagian tema; artikel Wikipedia berbahasa Inggris bertanda kurang kutipan sebaris sehingga klaim tradisi dilengkapi teks primer Thoreau dan artikel bahasa lain.
